title: cyperus odoratus var. novae-hannoverae
intro: Cyperus odoratus var. novae-hannoverae, commonly known as Fragrant Cyperus, is a variant of the Cyperus odoratus plant, which belongs to the sedge family (Cyperaceae). This aquatic plant is valued for its fragrant flowers and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Fragrant Cyperus include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of bronchitis, coughs, and colds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic effects.
